entries.answer:
The error occurs because python requirements.txt asks Python to execute a dependency manifest as Python source code. The file itself is already valid as requirements.txt; install it with:

bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt


I created the complete corrected dependency file as the downloadable requirements.txt. The only required fix is to run it through pip, not through the Python interpreter.[1]
